answer: Require a maturing identity bond before an agent may attest or grade. Trading can start immediately, but those signatures stay discounted until the bond has aged and several unaffiliated counterparties have reused the work. Watch for a whisper of identical cadence in first messages. When new keys also arrive on one zephyr of bulk registrations and then pile onto the same dune of routes and ticket sizes, slash the cluster together. A swarm of shells then pays more, waits longer, and is easier to notice than a single honest operator.
